sensitivity: Alpaca-only; matched dates; exclude terminal-dependent current/prior anchors
benchmark_cohort: eligible training only; validation and combined pretest not evaluated in Stage 1
bar_timestamp: UTC bar start; close available one minute later
adjustment: Alpaca split-only; patch native locally aligned, no scaling/dividend adjustment
prior_close: preceding scheduled full session C15:59; skip early closes only; never skip missing full anchor
rv: sqrt(log(C0930/O0930)^2 + sum(log(Cnext/Cprev)^2)); all 30 valid OHLC; Z=log(RV+epsilon)
zero_rv: retain legitimate zero with epsilon; diagnose count, no outcome filtering
required_minutes: 09:30..09:59,14:59,15:00..15:59; all 91 valid plus prior full close
hac_lag_unit: successive eligible daily observations; no calendar-gap padding
rv_groups: eligible principal training empirical quantiles 1/3,2/3, linear interpolation; lower bin includes boundary; no later-period quantiles
matched_group_cutoffs: principal training cutoffs fixed for matched-date and source sensitivities; own-cohort retrospective bins separately disclosed
terminal_sensitivity: exclude any day whose current required windows or prior anchor depend on one_sided_terminal_gap rows
models: pooled RV group intercepts and x slopes, high-minus-low contrast
ex_dividend_coverage: D1 issuer-verified example only; other dates unknown, not negative event flags
